name: Tony Medina as a duo: Don't Drink the Water, a Dave Matthews Band cover
seoTitle: Tony Medina as a duo: Don't Drink the Water
description: Here's Tony Medina as a duo, playing Don't Drink the Water by the Dave Matthews Band. He can also play solo, or bring a band of up to four.
more: For a retreat evening in the mountains, Tony can play the acoustic side of his song list solo or as a duo. He's on the quiet side when he plays alone, and he can bring the volume up or down to suit your venue. If you're not sure which size fits your event, we're happy to help you pick.
